## A. Five facts that decide what to build

1. **No real-process run of the business case exists at this head.** The registered Body-process tests (acceptance/missions.json:31) include no N3/N4/N7 test. Mission G gap G1 is OPEN and its next step names tests/integration/test_mission_g_business_loop.py (acceptance/missions.json:1566), which does not exist. The ten-step proof has no business-case step (tests/integration/test_one_machine_ten_steps.py:8-24).
2. **An unmerged branch already has one.** `origin/codex/business-path-process` at 650de5e5 (2026-11-05, not an ancestor of HEAD) adds tests/integration/test_greg_business_path_process.py (220 lines): N3, N4, N7 on one `greg run` process, a short-payment refusal and a SIGKILL restart after N3. Building that again would duplicate it.
3. **The rehearsal exists but reports no books.** `greg rehearse --path` runs three taught cases, a ratification, three SOP runs in a second venture and signed treasury requirements (greg/rehearsal.py:333-424). Its result carries node states only (greg/rehearsal.py:417-424), and its test asserts no money figure (tests/unit/test_greg_rehearse_path.py:58-108).
4. **The accounting columns live in three places.** Venture books hold verified revenue, signed tiers funded, shortfall and surplus (greg/venture_books.py:119-146), with no refunds and no costs. Refunds, dispute reserve and processor fees are separate accounts only on the Foundry #38 emulator rail (foundry/systems/payments.py:195-196, 292-316). Per-mission cost columns are in greg/mission_control.py:666-673.
5. **The map lags the tree on two dependencies.** WU-09 (S59.A1, acceptance/directive-sections.json:4751-4768, "standing approvals do not regress after failure") does not cite greg/autonomy.py:1-36 or tests/unit/test_greg_standing_approval_regression.py:1 ("WU-09 part A"). MW-C (S52.A1, :4335-4350, "Only a prose convergence map exists") does not cite tests/unit/test_canonical_owner_guard.py:1-7.
